symptom: The current-source frontend image could not be built, so Compose did not replace the running stack.
evidence: TypeScript TS2339 at Goals.tsx lines 128-129 reports that label and icon do not exist on the Goal side of a Goal/design-card union.

root_cause.summary: A conditional array expression produces a union whose item type is not narrowed sufficiently before the fallback design-card properties are read.

actions_attempted: Validated Compose interpolation and Docker daemon availability.
Observed the same TypeScript error in the host production build and Docker frontend build.
Inspected Compose state and classified all healthy application containers as stale-image evidence.
After researcher authorization, introduced an explicit ExpenseGoalCard view model and rebuilt the frontend and backend images.
Recreated the application containers and waited for all services to become healthy.
reusable_resolution: Separate fetched Goal rows from fallback design-card rows or add an explicit type guard before accessing label and icon.
prevention: Avoid mapping directly over conditional arrays whose branches have unrelated structural types under strict TypeScript.
